# ScalMint

> ScalMint builds software, data and AI systems that turn business needs into measurable results. Accra, Ghana.

Site: https://scalmint.com
Affiliate program: https://affiliate.scalmint.com
Contact: support@scalmint.com

## What ScalMint is
ScalMint is a software company. Digital transformation is every modern business's job; we build the systems that make it measurable — web, mobile and desktop applications, AI automation, structured data, and model fine-tuning.

## Products
- Nova POS — point of sale for retail, restaurants and multi-branch teams. https://pos.scalmint.com
- Operasch — operations, SOPs and field execution. https://smartsos.cloud
- Jarvis — AI PDF study assistant (coming soon)
- JobFinder — structured job intelligence (coming soon)

## Services
Software development, AI automation, structured data, model fine-tuning, systems integration, managed operations.

## Affiliate program
https://affiliate.scalmint.com — promote the products above. Recurring commission on Nova POS (up to 30%) and Operasch (up to 25%). Payouts in Ghana via Paystack to MTN MoMo or bank.
